description: the woman of the reference picture riding: a primeval goddess of the hunt, light tan skin, long light brown hair in braids, a strong face in clean profile, eyes glowing amber, the head of a giant white wolf worn as a hood with huge curved golden-brown aurochs horns rising from it, the white wolf pelt hanging down her back as a long fur mantle, a deep crimson bodice, a necklace of great fangs, brown leather belts, olive brown trousers, ivory greaves and brown boots, no bow, no knife, no wolves and nothing in the hands but the reins; sitting tall and upright astride a saddle that is not drawn, the back straight, not squatting and not crouching, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the head, chest and hips turned fully to the right; both forearms reaching forward, the two hands together in front of the body holding short reins that end just in front of the hands; only the near leg showing and only one foot in the whole picture: the thigh lying forward and level from the hip to the knee, the knee bent at a right angle, the lower leg hanging vertically straight down from the knee, one whole foot at the bottom with the toes pointing right; the cloak and any long hair hanging down behind the back, not spread out; the far leg completely hidden and not drawn at all, no second boot and no second foot; the whole figure from the tips of the horns to the sole of the foot inside the picture with room around it; nothing under the rider; isolated figure on a plain background

references.usage: the character's look: this same woman, her face, braids, wolf hood with the horns, fur mantle, clothes and colours, drawn the same way; not her standing pose and not the bow, the knife and the spirit wolves
